_note: What you see: Recording the decision on a Woo request (Open Government Act) with the decision letter; if the municipal executive decides, via a proposal in decidiq.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Het besluit op een Woo-verzoek vastleggen met de besluitbrief; besluit het college, dan via een voorstel in decidiq.
De zaak gaat naar stap 3, besluit. Het b: The case moves to step 3, decision. The decision is built from the 7 assessed documents.
Voorstel uit de beoordeling: 4 openbaar,: Proposal from the assessment: 4 public, 2 partly public, 1 not public
Geen van de documenten wordt openbaar, d: None of the documents becomes public, the reason is in the decision
Overgenomen uit de beoordeling. Wijzigen: Taken from the assessment. You change it per document.
De adviezen en het raadsvoorstel maken w: We publish the advice and the council proposal. In the contractor's mail and the complaints list we redact residents' names and addresses. The internal note on the budget stays closed, because it contains personal policy views.
Komt in het besluit en in de reden van d: Goes into the decision and into the reason for this step
Wat nu? Besluiten vraagt twee dingen: st: What now? Deciding takes two things: draft the decision and record it. The letter comes first.
Besluit het college of de burgemeester?: Does the municipal executive or the mayor decide? Then you make a proposal in decidiq, via the Decisions tab (Make proposal). The decision then appears on this case by itself.
Na het vastleggen staat de publicatie kl: After recording, the publication is ready. With Publish (Woo) in More, group Publication, the 6 public and partly public documents go to the reading room. What is not public never goes along.
